About

Project Overview

Project Overview

NURSE-LABS is an Erasmus+ Cooperation Partnership in Vocational Education and Training focused on strengthening nurses' capacity to provide structured counselling and adherence support in chronic vision care. The project responds to the absence of a validated European competence architecture linking clinical evidence, measurable learning outcomes, digital simulation and professional development in this field.

Why the Project Matters

Chronic conditions such as glaucoma, age-related macular degeneration and diabetic retinopathy require sustained patient engagement, follow-up and understanding of treatment pathways. Nurses are often central to patient education and continuity of care, yet training in adherence counselling and chronic vision communication remains fragmented. NURSE-LABS addresses this gap by moving from knowledge-based education toward observable, assessable professional competence.

Target Groups

  • Nursing students and VET learners
  • Practising nurses involved in chronic care
  • Nurse educators and clinical supervisors
  • Professional nursing associations and CPD bodies
  • VET and higher education institutions
  • Healthcare organisations and clinical services
  • Health literacy organisations and public-health stakeholders
  • Policy and workforce stakeholders

Work Packages

WP1 - Project Management

Governance, coordination, quality, risk, financial monitoring and reporting.

WP2 - BIG IDEAS Development & Delphi Validation

Development and three-round expert validation of the European competence architecture.

WP3 - Curriculum Structuring & EQF Alignment

Translation of validated competences into learning outcomes, assessment and an EQF-aligned curriculum.

WP4 - Digital LMS Ecosystem & Simulation Development

Development of the digital learning environment, interactive simulations, analytics and micro-credentials.

WP5 - Transnational Pilot Implementation

Implementation and evaluation of the training model in participating European settings.

WP6 - Impact Evaluation, Sustainability & Exploitation

Impact consolidation, CPD integration, policy alignment, sustainability, dissemination and Community of Practice.
